<thought>Only sulfur shows a clear M+2 isotopic peak (~5‑6% of the base peak) consistent with its natural 34S abundance (~4%). No chlorine or bromine pattern (M+2 ≈ 33% or ≈ 100%) is present, and other elements lack distinctive signatures. Thus sulfur is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
